item.name: Submit a Sql Statement for Execution.

request.name: Submit a Sql Statement for Execution.

description.content: Submits one or more SQL statements for execution. You can specify that the statement should be executed asynchronously. The following statement types are not supported: PUT, GET, USE, ALTER SESSION, BEGIN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, statements that set session variables, and statements that create temporary tables and stages.

query.description: Unique ID of the API request. This ensures that the execution is idempotent. If not specified, a new UUID is generated and assigned.

Set to true to execute the statement asynchronously and return the statement handle. If the parameter is not specified or is set to false, a statement is executed and the first result is returned if the execution is completed in 45 seconds. If the statement execution takes longer to complete, the statement handle is returned.
Set to true to execute the statement to generate the result set including null. If the parameter is set to false, the result set value null will be replaced with the string 'null'.

Specify the authorization token type for the Authorization header. KEYPAIR_JWT is for Keypair JWT, OAUTH for oAuth token, or PROGRAMMATIC_ACCESS_TOKEN for programmatic access tokens. If not specified, OAUTH is assumed.

response.name: The statement was executed successfully, and the response includes any data requested.
